svg.title: dsh-bid-health-check dual-channel merge
svg.desc: RequirementsPack items and bid .docx paragraphs merge into one longest-common-substring measure: under 4 characters falls back to the requirement quote, 5 or more locates a paragraph and ties take the longer one. Three caps keep a located hit at weak: a heading of 12 characters or fewer, overlap with the quote only at 6 or more, or a reject-clause category. The gate fans out to responded, weak and not-located; the quickstart run gives 2, 3 and 6. A bypass rail carries the tier C requirement: it never enters the measure, is reported as blockedByPack, stays inside the not-located group, and the bidder is never graded on it.

text.font-family: 'Microsoft YaHei','Segoe UI','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC',sans-serif
